title: Understanding Agglomerative Clustering
text: Agglomerative clustering starts with each data point as its own cluster and merges them step by step. Think about how many clusters you start with and how many you want to end up with.

title: Linkage Method
text: Average linkage considers the average distance between all pairs of data points in two clusters. How might this affect the merging process compared to other linkage methods?

title: Counting Iterations
text: If you start with $$6$$ pandas, how many merges do you need to end up with $$1$$ cluster?
